_comment: Discord integration for the launcher. Set verifyUrl to your bot's verify endpoint (e.g. https://your-domain/verify) once the VPS is up, and inviteUrl to your Discord invite. codeUrl is optional: where 'Get a code in Discord' sends the user — set it to the bot's DM (https://discord.com/users/<botUserId>) so they land straight on the bot; leave blank to fall back to the invite. The launcher reads this live, so no launcher release is needed to change them. Empty verifyUrl = the launcher still shows Log in with Discord, but says linking isn't switched on yet.
